text:
Lina: Heads-up: I'm sketching a tiny CLI shim called `deployx` to produce canonical one-line deploys for runbooks. Thoughts?
Marco: yes — single source of truth for flags would cut down our copies.
Priya: +1. can it also emit a reversible manifest so ops can `promote`/`rollback` easily?
Alex: Make the defaults conservative. canary=2, auto-rollback=true, snapshot-db=false.
Eli: I like a `deployx gen` that outputs a template and a companion `deployx preview` that shows planned steps and risks.
Lina: Example output sketch: 
```
deploy service=payments ref=sha:fa1c2 profile=hotfix window=2026-04-01T02:00/03:00 notes="fix rounding" 
# expands to: 
service=payments ref=sha:fa1c2 canary=2 preflight=smoke auto-rollback=1h snapshot-db=false pin=false
```
Marco: release-bot should be able to expand macros server-side and attach a `manifest-id` to the expanded deploy so we can track and reverse it.
release-bot: I can implement expansion + manifest creation. I'd prefer server-side so policies are enforced centrally.
Priya: ops-bot integration: when preflight list is non-empty, post a checklist thread and wait for approvals. If `--auto-approve` is passed, proceed after lint.
Alex: Add `--escape` shorthand for on-call: `deployx escape payments reason="incident"` does a two-step rollback (mark old manifest promote, run promote job).
Eli: What about pinning rules? For enterprise orgs require `pin-justification` and disallow pins longer than 48h without legal ok. release-bot should block.
Lina: Also include `--snapshot` which uploads a schema+migration snapshot to S3 and returns a checkpoint id. CLI prints: `checkpoint=ckpt_20260401_001`.
Marco: CLI suggestion: `deployx template create --service payments --profile hotfix --window 2026-04-01T02:00/03:00` -> prints a one-liner you can paste in runbooks.
Priya: UX: `deployx notes --edit --manifest manifest-id` opens a small modal to fill title, summary, rollback instructions and attaches it to the manifest. Saves errors for product.
Alex: For metrics-based auto-rollback standardize thresholds and names: `auto-rollback=1h:metrics(p95>500ms,5xx>0.5%)`. Keep a sane default so devs don't have to think.
release-bot: I'll add a preview endpoint that returns expanded args, generated manifest, and a checklist payload. Also will validate pin compatibility with infra pins.
ops-bot: For preflight I will post a checklist and require two approvals; the checklist will include smoke URL, healthcheck, and migration checkpoint verification when snapshot is requested.
Eli: Implementation note: store profiles in `infra/deployx-profiles.yaml` and keep macro expansion rules small so teams can add local profiles.
Lina: Next actions: I'll prototype `deployx gen` + preview endpoint. Marco take bot manifest plumbing. Priya wire checklist. Alex do `--escape` flow. Eli draft deployx-profiles.yaml sample.
Marco: I'll also add a `deployx lint` command that checks metrics presence, infra pin conflicts, and DB snapshot ability before submitting.
Lina: Great. I'll open a draft PR with PoC and a sample runbook snippet once ready. :rocket:
